landing.testimonial1Text: Muqabaleh helped me practice before my real interview at Riyad Bank. The four-criteria evaluation gave me a clear picture of my weaknesses.
landing.testimonial2Text: I was afraid of English interviews, but Fahd helped me build my confidence. After 3 sessions my score improved from 62 to 88.

landing.faqQ1: How does the smart interviewer work?
landing.faqA1: The smart interviewer uses an advanced AI model designed specifically for Arabic interviews. It asks one question at a time, follows up adaptively, and evaluates you based on four criteria: content, clarity, confidence, and cultural fit.
landing.faqQ2: Can I choose the interview type?
landing.faqA2: Yes. When starting a new session you select the field (tech, finance, medical, etc.), experience level, and interview type (behavioral or technical). The interviewer adapts questions based on your choices.
landing.faqQ3: How long does one interview take?
landing.faqA3: A typical interview consists of 6-8 questions and usually takes 15-20 minutes depending on your answer length. You can stop at any time.
landing.faqQ4: Are my data and interviews private?
landing.faqA4: Absolutely. All data is encrypted and never shared with third parties. Voice conversations are not recorded or stored as audio files — we only retain transcripts for evaluation. You can delete your account and all data anytime.
landing.faqA5: We accept PayPal (credit and debit cards supported). All prices in USD. You can see the estimate in your local currency next to each plan.
landing.faqA6: Yes. If a session is not completed due to a technical issue on our side, the amount is automatically refunded within 24 hours. For refunds, contact support.

about.heroH1: Building the Future of Arab Employment
about.heroSub: Muqabaleh is the first Arabic platform for AI-powered job interview practice. We believe every Arab professional deserves a fair chance to shine in their interviews.
about.missionDesc: To empower Arab professionals with objective, accurate interview practice and verified reports that boost their career opportunities.
about.visionDesc: To become the Arab standard for candidate readiness assessment — a platform trusted by employers and job seekers alike.
about.valuesSub: Six principles that guide every decision we make at Muqabaleh.
about.v1Desc: Evaluations based on clear, measurable criteria — free from personal bias.
about.v2Desc: User data is encrypted and protected. We never share information with third parties.
about.v3Desc: Every detail — from content to experience — is designed specifically for Arabic speakers.
about.v4Desc: We support 8 Arab countries and aim to cover all Arabic-speaking markets.
about.v5Desc: Clear reports, detailed scores, and QR-verified certificates.
about.v6Desc: We develop our AI models and improve evaluations based on user feedback.
about.storyP1: The idea for Muqabaleh came from a real experience: qualified Arab candidates failing interviews not because of a lack of competence, but because of insufficient practice in crafting answers and handling the pressure of a real interview.
about.storyP2: We saw a major gap in the Arab market: Western platforms don't support Arabic well enough, and interview training is limited to expensive courses or friends conducting unstructured mock interviews.
about.storyP3: So we built Muqabaleh: an AI-powered smart interviewer that conducts realistic interviews in Arabic and English, evaluates answers across four independent criteria, and issues QR-verified reports.
about.storyP4: Today, Muqabaleh serves thousands of professionals across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Jordan, and Egypt — and we continue to expand.
about.ctaSub: Start a free mock interview — no sign-up required.

legal.privacyP1: Muqabaleh is committed to protecting the privacy of its users in accordance with this Privacy Policy. This policy applies to all individual and corporate users who use the platform's services.
legal.privacyP2: We collect the following data upon registration and service use: full name, email address, country (optional), field of work, and experience level. We also collect interview data including transcribed answer texts, AI evaluations, and standardized scores.
legal.privacyP3: No-Recording Policy: We do not record or store any audio files during interviews. We use real-time speech-to-text technology for evaluation purposes only, and do not retain audio recordings after the session ends.
legal.privacyP4: We do not activate any services or share data by default without the user's explicit consent. Users must provide prior consent before any additional processing of their data.
legal.privacyP5: User data and interview results are retained for twelve (12) months from the date of the last account activity. After this period, data is automatically deleted or permanently anonymized.
legal.privacyP6: Users have the right to request deletion of their account and all associated data at any time through the profile settings or by submitting a request to the support team. Deletion requests are processed within seven (7) business days.
legal.privacyP7: We do not share user data with any third parties except in the following cases: with the user's explicit consent, to fulfill enforceable legal obligations, or to protect the rights of the platform and its users.
legal.privacyP8: We use advanced encryption protocols (TLS 1.3) for data transmission and AES-256 encryption for storage. All connections between the browser and our servers are fully encrypted.
legal.privacyP9: We use essential cookies necessary for operating the platform and improving user experience. We do not use cookies for advertising tracking or sharing data with external advertising networks.
legal.privacyP10: The platform may not be used by persons under the age of eighteen (18). If an account belonging to a minor is discovered, it will be immediately cancelled and all data deleted.
legal.privacyP11: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Any changes are published on this page with an updated revision date. Users are notified of material changes via email or an in-platform notification.
legal.privacyP12: For any inquiries regarding this Privacy Policy or data protection practices, please contact us through the Help Center page or via email: privacy@muqabaleh.com.
legal.privacyP13: This policy is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Any dispute arising from this policy shall be resolved amicably first, then through the competent courts in the Kingdom.
legal.privacyP14: In the event of a security breach affecting user data, we are committed to notifying affected users within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering the breach, providing details about the nature of the affected data and actions taken.
legal.privacyP15: By using the Muqabaleh platform, you agree to the collection and use of your data in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with any provision, please do not use the platform.
legal.termsP1: These Terms and Conditions (Terms) govern your use of the Muqabaleh platform and its associated services. By registering on or using the platform, you agree to comply with these Terms in full.
legal.termsP2: Muqabaleh is an electronic platform providing job interview training services using artificial intelligence and certified human interviewers. Services include: AI interviews, human interviews, evaluation reports, and verified digital certificates.
legal.termsP3: Each user must create only one account. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials. Any activity occurring from an account is the responsibility of the account holder.
legal.termsP4: The platform may not be used for illegal or abusive purposes, including but not limited to: attempting to breach the platform's systems, sending harmful or offensive content, using the platform in ways that harm others, or attempting to manipulate the evaluation system.
legal.termsP5: All prices are displayed in US Dollars and payments are processed via PayPal. The amount is deducted immediately upon payment confirmation. Prices are subject to change with prior notice to existing users.
legal.termsP6: Users are entitled to an automatic refund within twenty-four (24) hours if the session is not completed due to a technical issue on the platform's side. Users are not entitled to a refund after the session is completed and the report is delivered.
legal.termsP7: All content, designs, logos, trademarks, and software associated with the Muqabaleh platform are protected intellectual property. No part of the platform may be copied, reused, or distributed without prior written permission.
legal.termsP8: Muqabaleh shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the platform. The maximum liability of the platform shall not exceed the amount paid by the user in the preceding twelve (12) months.
legal.termsP9: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are resolved amicably first, and if amicable resolution fails, through the competent courts in the city of Riyadh.
legal.termsP10: Muqabaleh reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time with prior notice to users via email or an in-platform notification. Continued use of the platform after modifications are published constitutes implicit acceptance.
legal.termsP11: The platform may suspend or terminate the account of any user who violates these Terms without prior notice in cases of serious violation. Users have the right to appeal a suspension decision within fifteen (15) days.
legal.termsP12: Muqabaleh does not guarantee that evaluations produced by interviews will necessarily reflect a user's performance in real job interviews. Evaluations are indicative guidance only.
legal.termsP13: Certificates issued by the platform are digital certificates used for training and professional development purposes. They are not a substitute for any academic or professional certificate accredited by an official body.
legal.termsP14: In the event of any discrepancy between the Arabic and English versions of these Terms, the Arabic version shall be the authoritative reference.
legal.termsP15: For any inquiries regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact us through the Help Center page or via email: legal@muqabaleh.com.
legal.refundP1: This Refund Policy governs the conditions for reimbursing amounts paid for Muqabaleh platform services.
legal.refundP2: If an interview session is not completed due to a technical issue on the platform's side (service interruption, system error, or any technical failure), the amount is automatically refunded to the user's account within twenty-four (24) hours.
legal.refundP3: To request a refund outside the scope of automatic refunds, please contact the support team through the Help Center page, providing the order number, purchase date, and reason for the request.
legal.refundP4: Approved refund requests are processed within three (3) to five (5) business days. The refunded amount appears in the user's account within five (5) to ten (10) business days, depending on PayPal's policies.
legal.refundP5: For payments made via PayPal, the amount is returned to the same account from which payment was made. PayPal may charge fees for refund transactions according to its own policies.
legal.refundP6: For Business (B2B) accounts, refund terms differ according to the signed agreement. Corporate refund requests are handled in accordance with the terms of the contract signed with each company individually.
legal.refundP7: For human interview bookings, users may cancel the appointment and receive a full credit if cancellation is made at least twenty-four (24) hours before the scheduled time. Cancellation after this period does not qualify for a refund.
legal.refundP8: Users are not entitled to a refund after the interview session is completed and the evaluation report is delivered. Once the report is delivered, the service is considered complete and is not subject to refund.
legal.refundP9: If a user provides false or misleading information during registration or during the interview that affects the quality of the evaluation, they are not entitled to claim a refund.
legal.refundP10: This Refund Policy does not cover fees or government taxes imposed on financial transactions. Users are responsible for any additional fees charged by the payment service provider.
legal.refundP11: Muqabaleh reserves the right to reject refund requests that are submitted repeatedly or are suspected of representing abuse of the refund policy.
legal.refundP12: For any inquiries regarding this Refund Policy or the status of a specific refund request, please contact the support team through the Help Center page or via email: billing@muqabaleh.com.

passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your password for your account. Click the button below to set a new password.
passwordReset.fallbackLink: If the button doesn't work, copy this link:
passwordReset.securityBody: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't request this, ignore this email.
passwordReset.footerNote: Didn't reset your password? You can safely ignore this email — your password won't change.

interviewerApplicationReceived.subject: We Received Your Interviewer Application
interviewerApplicationReceived.heading: Thank you for applying 🙏
interviewerApplicationReceived.body: {interviewerName}, we've received your application to join Muqabaleh as an interviewer.
interviewerApplicationReceived.reviewNote: Our team will review your application within 24-48 hours. We verify the experience and certifications you listed to maintain platform quality.
interviewerApplicationReceived.nextStep: We'll email you once your application is approved, with instructions to activate your account and start accepting bookings.
interviewerApplicationReceived.supportNote: If you have any questions, contact our support team

interviewerApproved.subject: You're Approved! Start Earning on Muqabaleh
interviewerApproved.heading: Congratulations! 🎉
interviewerApproved.body: {interviewerName}, your interviewer profile is now live on Muqabaleh.
interviewerApproved.stepsIntro: To start accepting bookings and earning, follow these steps:
interviewerApproved.step1: Set your availability and pricing from the dashboard
interviewerApproved.step2: Add your payment details (PayPal) to receive earnings
interviewerApproved.step3: Start accepting bookings and conducting interviews
interviewerApproved.earningsNote: You earn 80% of every session fee — we handle the rest.

interviewerNewBooking.subject: New Session Booked — {date} with {userName}
interviewerNewBooking.heading: New Session Booked! 📅
interviewerNewBooking.body: {interviewerName}, a new interview session has been booked with you.
interviewerNewBooking.reminder: Please join at least 5 minutes before the session. The meeting link remains valid until the session ends.

interviewerPayoutSent.subject: Your Payout of {amount} Has Been Sent
interviewerPayoutSent.heading: Payout Sent ✅
interviewerPayoutSent.body: {interviewerName}, your payout has been successfully transferred to your PayPal account.
interviewerPayoutSent.deliveryNote: The funds may take 1-3 business days to appear in your PayPal account.

adminNewApplication.subject: Action Required: New Interviewer Application from {interviewerName}
adminNewApplication.heading: New Interviewer Application 🔔
adminNewApplication.body: A new interviewer application has been submitted and requires your review.

adminDailySummary.heading: Daily Summary 📊
adminDailySummary.body: Here's an overview of platform activity for {date}.
